recommendations.title: RECOMMENDATIONS
recommendations.heading: Things to consider
recommendations.subtitle: Personalized insights based on your nutrition

initial.title: Analyzing your diet
initial.message: Add meals to receive personalized nutrition recommendations.

empty.title: Your diet looks balanced
empty.message: There are no critical recommendations at the moment. Keep tracking your nutrition throughout the day.

protein_progress.title: Protein target still available
protein_progress.message: You have about {value} g of protein remaining to reach your daily target. Add a protein source to your next meals.

low.title: Low calorie intake
low.message: By the end of the day, you have consumed significantly fewer calories than planned. If you are planning another meal, consider making it more nutritious.

remaining.title: Room left in your daily calorie target
remaining.message: About {value} kcal remain to reach your estimated daily target.

excess.title: Daily calorie intake exceeded
excess.message: Your current intake is about {value} kcal above your target.

macro_insufficient.title: Not enough {macro}
macro_insufficient.message: About {value} g of {macro} remain to reach your estimated target.

macro_balance.title: Uneven macronutrient distribution
macro_balance.message: The share of {macro} in your current diet is noticeably {direction} than the estimated balance. Try making your next meals more varied.

processed.title: High share of processed foods
processed.message: A significant part of your diet consists of processed foods. Try adding more whole and minimally processed foods.

whole_foods.title: Few whole foods
whole_foods.message: For a more varied diet, add vegetables, fruits, grains, legumes, and other whole foods.

improvement.title: Room to improve your diet
improvement.message: Try making your diet more varied and increasing the share of nutritious whole foods.

empty.title: Start tracking your nutrition
empty.message: Add your first meal so NosiFit can evaluate your diet balance and provide personalized nutrition recommendations.

barcode.title: Barcode
barcode.hint: Point the camera at the barcode — it is recognised automatically.
barcode.cameraDenied: No camera access. Allow it in your browser settings or type the digits instead.
barcode.cameraUnavailable: The camera is not available on this device or browser. Type the digits under the barcode.
barcode.insecure: The camera only works over a secure (https) connection. Type the digits under the barcode.
barcode.decoderFailed: The scanner could not start. Type the digits under the barcode.
barcode.notFound: This product is neither in the NosiFit catalog nor in Open Food Facts. Create your own product from the label — next time this barcode will find it.
barcode.external: Open Food Facts — community data, not verified by NosiFit. Check it against the label.
barcode.notImportable: This data is not enough for tracking. Create your own product from the label.
barcode.stale: Open Food Facts is unavailable right now — showing previously saved data.
barcode.attribution: Data: Open Food Facts, ODbL licence.

warnings.per_100ml: Values are per 100 ml. Logging in ml is exact; in grams 1 g = 1 ml is assumed.
warnings.converted_from_serving: Some values were converted from a serving to 100 g using the serving weight on the label.
warnings.energy_mismatch: Calories differ noticeably from the macros — check the label.
warnings.no_nutrition_data: The database says the package has no nutrition facts.
warnings.basis_uncertain: It is not clear whether the values are per 100 g or per 100 ml — check the label.
